value.quote: they may strategize as they wish.
value.note: There is no separate notation. The introduction says outright that voters may strategize, so what they submit may differ from the projects they would like to fund. This meets the textual criterion for DIST, although the formal model applies the rules to the approval profile directly.

C2.4.reason: The codebook allows DIST on text saying submitted inputs may differ from held attitudes, and 'they may strategize as they wish' is such text.
